hook: You vote the water up or down: coots float, both front rows drown, and every swing grows your board.
loop: Raise or Drain the Level, ideally both, each turn.
Every change pays stats or gold; Afloat and Dike slots stay dry.
The Flood takes Health shares from both front rows before attacks.

growth.line: +1/+1s per Level change early; Kobus doubles them at Tier 4; Tier 6 swings grow everything in jumps.

feel.early: Coots raise the Level; Level 1 pings enemy fronts.
feel.mid: Front-row slot puzzle: who floats, who sits by Dikes.
feel.late: Big swings grow the board; Level 5 halves front rows.

stars.why: Raise and Drain every turn: two changes, Level unmoved.
Turns one vote into a full swing to 5 or 0.
Your Floods spare you and reach the enemy back row.

card_short.u01: Afloat. Raise when played or sold.
card_short.u02: Afloat. Grows each time the Level changes, twice a turn.
card_short.u03: Afloat. Gives a unit Afloat, or stats if already Afloat.
card_short.u04: Dike. Each Raise buffs the units beside it.
card_short.u05: Start of Turn: Raise or Drain; gold on a Drain.
card_short.u06: End of Turn: Raise and Drain, two changes.
card_short.u07: Afloat. Raise whenever you sell a unit.
card_short.u08: Dike. Each Drain buffs a random other unit.
card_short.u09: Afloat. Gains Attack per enemy hurt by each Flood.
card_short.u10: Afloat. Your Level-change triggers fire twice.
card_short.u11: Start of Combat: Raise 2 for this fight.
card_short.u12: End of Turn: buffs front units ahead, more per Level.
card_short.u13: Afloat. Buffs Afloat units each turn; double at Level 0.
card_short.u14: Dike. Friendly deaths bring the Flood again, twice a fight.
card_short.u15: Each Level change gives your smallest unit +3/+3.
card_short.u16: Afloat. First Flood buffs your Afloat units per enemy hurt.
card_short.u17: Twice a turn, carry any Raise or Drain all the way.
card_short.u18: Your Floods spare your units and hit the enemy back row.
card_short.u19: Each Drain buffs all your units; extra at Level 0.
card_short.x01: Spell: Raise or Drain 1, twice, choosing each time.

builds.name: High Water
builds.line: Hold Level 4–5; floating front row cashes in every Flood.

builds.name: The Minutes
builds.line: Swing the Level every turn; Kobus and Hendrika multiply change payoffs.

builds.name: Dry Polder
builds.line: Drain low for gold and stats; Aaltje still floods in fights.

liked: One visible water Level that floods both front rows plays like no other tribe.
Polder Millwright and Hendrika make every turn's vote a real sequencing puzzle.
worries: Hendrika with Kobus and Nine Mills gives huge stats every turn; sim it.
Tail-Slapper's repeat Floods can near-wipe enemy boards; current or full Health is unclear.
changed: Fight votes now pay permanently; each Level step counts as one Raise or Drain.
Sluice Keeper can Raise or Drain; Winter Raft pays most at Level 0.
The Spaarndam Pup now stops only your own Floods, not the enemy's.
verdict: Trigger-chainers and slot-puzzle fans get a turn-by-turn vote on the water that floods both front rows.
